result.title: Recommending Bacterial Cultivation Conditions from 16S rRNA
result.summary: Recommending bacterial cultivation conditions from sequence data is a challenging structured problem characterized by missing standardized benchmarks and limited use of sequence structure. To address this, we introduce DSNI, a benchmark of 65,023 bacterial strains with phylogeny-aware splits, pairing 16S rRNA sequences with four cultivation conditions (media, temperature, pH, oxygen). Exploiting the mosaic structure of 16S rRNA, where hypervariable regions support discrimination and conserved regions support primer design, we propose a Variability-Gated Encoder that learns position-dependent importance weights conditioned on biological features (region type, position, and local complexity). The gating module adds minimal overhead (1,280 parameters, <1%) while providing an explicit inductive bias valuable in low-data regimes. Experiments demonstrate that the learnable gate improves flat Transformers by 4.7% in joint accuracy and complements RNABERT, yielding 44.2% exact-match joint accuracy. The model also recovers 90.2% of ground-truth cultivation protocols within its top-25 recommendations, narrowing the exhaustive search space by approximately 60 times.

AI.brief_summary: 构建包含 65,023 株细菌的 DSNI 基准，将 16S rRNA 序列与培养基、温度、pH、氧气四种培养条件配对，并提出按区域类型、位置和局部复杂度学习位置相关权重的 Variability-Gated Encoder 进行联合预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作与视觉推理无关，但其依据序列分区与位置结构学习 token 重要性的轻量门控，可能可供核查作为视觉 token 证据筛选或重要性加权的参照思路。
